tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek has open-sourced an artificial intelligence model as China and the US restrict each other's technology. Reported by Bloomberg.
Microsoft's artificial intelligence tool called MAI-DxO beat generalist doctors at step-by-step diagnosis, with 83.2% accuracy in complex cases. Confirmed by The Next Web.
Functionize has launched an MCP server that links coding agents to live app testing for real-time validation. Confirmed by SecurityBrief New Zealand.
LTM has launched an artificial intelligence lab in Chennai to accelerate industrial artificial intelligence adoption and scale solutions. Confirmed by MediaNews4U.
OpenAI and Google are enabling enterprise artificial intelligence access via Google Cloud with three GPT-6 models in private preview. Reported by Channel Insider.
Free every hour.
